build_iou_metric_evaluator: build an IoUMetric evaluator to calculate mIoU, mDice, and mFscore for semantic segmentation
process_batch_predictions: process a batch of model predictions and ground truth labels to compute intersection and union
compute_segmentation_metrics: compute per class and overall segmentation metrics including accuracy, IoU, Dice, and F-score
calculate_intersect_and_union: calculate intersection and union histograms between predicted and ground truth segmentation masks
convert_areas_to_metrics: convert total area intersect, union, and label arrays into IoU, Dice, and F-score metrics
